quantitative_overrides.fin_note: Operating ROIC normalized to the 35.0% cap neutralizing DKK 26.8B of accumulated goodwill and intangibles from Kerecis and Atos Medical acquisitions (GAAP ROIC 19.19%). Forward 5-10Y compound growth of 7.5% driven by 5.5% organic volume in chronic ostomy and continence care, 1.5% innovation price-mix (SenSura Mio, Luja), and 0.5% post-acquisition margin recovery. Highly resilient non-cyclical consumable demand with 86.5% FCF conversion.
